_README: Every PinClicks DOM selector lives here. NOTHING is hardcoded in Python.
When PinClicks changes its markup, you fix this file only -- no code changes.
primary   : the selector to try first
fallbacks : tried in order if primary finds nothing
required  : true  -> preflight refuses to run if this cannot be found
false -> missing value becomes 'N/A' and the scrape continues
attr      : optional; read this attribute instead of the text content
PinClicks is a Laravel Livewire app (wire:model / wire:submit attributes).
That means server-rendered HTML updated over AJAX, and NO data-testid hooks.
Prefer stable anchors: element ids, wire:model names, and href patterns.
Avoid Tailwind utility classes -- they change with any restyle.

urls._routes: VERIFIED sidebar routes: /keyword-explorer, /link-explorer, /pins (Top Pins), /stats, /saved, /rankings, /searches, /saved-keywords, /accounts, /settings, /billing, /logout. A single keyword drills down to /keyword/{slug}/{pinterest_id}.
urls._note: VERIFIED: /keyword-explorer is where PinClicks lands you after login, and it is protected (redirects to /login when logged out) which makes it the correct session-probe target. /dashboard is a 404 -- do not use it.

logged_out_marker._status: VERIFIED against the live login page

_level1_note: Level 1 = the 'Interests' panel on /keyword-explorer. Each interest is a <label for='filter-{ID}'> holding a checkbox, the name, the volume, and a drill-down button wire:click=setTopInterest('{ID}'). The ID is Pinterest's own interest id and is stable.
_level2_note: Level 2 = the Filament results table. Rows carry data-key={pinterest id}. The keyword cell links to /keyword/{keyword}/{id}, which is also the drill-down URL. Sortable columns are 'label' and 'search_volume'. NOTE: this table PAGINATES (wire:click=gotoPage(N,'tablePage')) -- it does not infinite-scroll.

row_volume._status: UNVERIFIED column index - confirm against a live table
